name: What types of interior garage upgrades are most common for homes in the Bay Area?

mainEntity.name: What types of interior garage upgrades are most common for homes in the Bay Area?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common garage interior upgrades in the Bay Area include installing custom cabinetry and shelving systems for improved organization, epoxy or polyaspartic floor coatings for durability and aesthetics, and enhanced lighting solutions. Many homeowners also opt for insulation and drywall finishing to convert their garage into a more functional space like a home office, gym, or additional living area. Workbench installations and specialized storage for bikes or sports equipment are also popular, maximizing the utility of the garage beyond just parking a car.
acceptedAnswer.description: Most common garage interior upgrades in the Bay Area include custom cabinetry, epoxy floor coatings, enhanced lighting, insulation, and drywall finishing for functional conversions.
